_readme: The tracks. Every track is an oval: two straights joined by two half-circle bends, run anticlockwise. straight = length of each straight in metres. radius = radius of the bends in metres (smaller is tighter). finishBeforeBend = how far the finish line is before bend 1. distances = race distances in metres, shortest first: [sprint, standard, stayers, marathon]. goingBase = how slow the sand usually rides (0 is normal, + is slower, - is faster; a day's going is this plus a random amount). Add a track by copying a whole { ... } block. The id must be unique and have no spaces.
